title: Deep Analog: Open-Set Film Emulation with Reference-Conditioned 3D LUTs
abstract: arXiv:2608.14702v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Film emulation reproduces the look of an analog film stock on a new digital photograph. We target its open-set form -- matching any reference film frame from a single example -- with a 3D lookup table (LUT) predicted from that reference. Real-time image enhancement predicts per-image weights over a fixed bank of 3D LUTs and blends them. We show this is a gated mixture of experts and inherits its failure: trained end-to-end against reconstruction, the gate collapses onto a single expert, so a bank of K LUTs delivers the capacity of one. An entropy term, the enhancement-setting analogue of mixture-of-experts load balancing, restores utilization and recovers about 1 dB PSNR. The deeper constraint survives: a fixed LUT basis is closed-set, freezing the achievable looks at training time. We therefore discard the basis and predict a single 3D LUT as a residual from a reference image (StyleLUTNet), trained by self-supervision on procedurally

translated_title: 深度模拟：基于参考条件3D LUT的开放集胶片仿真
translated_abstract: 胶片仿真是在新的数字照片上重现某种模拟胶片的外观。我们针对其开放集形式——即通过单一示例匹配任意参考胶片帧——采用从该参考预测出的3D查找表（LUT）来实现。实时图像增强方法会在固定的3D LUT库上预测每张图像的权重并混合它们。我们证明这本质上是门控混合专家模型，并继承了其缺陷：在端到端重建训练下，门控会坍缩到单一专家上，因此K个LUT的库仅提供单个LUT的能力。引入熵项（即混合专家负载均衡在增强设置中的类比）可恢复利用并提升约1 dB的峰值信噪比。更深层的约束依然存在：固定的LUT基础是封闭集的，将可实现的外观冻结在训练时。因此，我们摒弃了基础集，直接从参考图像预测单个3D LUT作为残差（StyleLUTNet），并通过程序化数据上的自监督进行训练。
tldr: 本文提出StyleLUTNet，通过从参考图像直接预测单个3D LUT，解决了开放集胶片仿真中固定LUT库导致的容量坍缩和封闭集限制，实现了任意参考风格的灵活匹配。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces StyleLUTNet, which predicts a single 3D LUT directly from a reference image, overcoming the capacity collapse and closed-set limitations of fixed LUT banks for open-set film emulation.
